meta.title: Recreate Order: Change the quantity in the pop-up
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary instead of searching the events list.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the setup.
Confirm the original event shows the prepared quantity of 10.
Record the original event's quantity display before recreating it.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch Recreate Order.
Confirm the Recreate Order popup opened with its Product Sheet section.
Confirm the expected scheduling control is present in the popup.
Change the recreated order quantity from 10 to 15.
Create the new event using the changed quantity.
Verify the newly created event asks for quantity 15.
Return to the original closed RFQ.
Verify the original event still shows its quantity of 10.
